events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with the US showing military strength but also facing limitations in its geopolitical power. This escalation is expected to impact global energy markets and inflation.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation is expected to lead to higher energy prices, which will drive inflation up. This will likely lead to a decrease in bond prices, making it a good time to short TLT. On the other hand, the S&P 500 is expected to remain resilient, making it a good buy.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the Iran war de-escalates or when the Fed changes its interest rate policy

gains.extendedNote: If the war spreads to other regions
